# vastdata_topic (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vastdata_topic" "vastdb_topic" {
  database_name    = "vastdb_bucket"
  name             = "vastdb_topic"
  topic_partitions = 3
  retention_ms     = 86400000 # 1 day retention
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `database_name` (String) Name of the Database
- `name` (String) Name of the Topic
- `topic_partitions` (Number) Amount of Kafka Topic partitions

### Optional

- `message_timestamp_after_max_ms` (Number) Message timestamp 'after' threshold in milli-seconds
- `message_timestamp_before_max_ms` (Number) Message timestamp 'before' threshold in milli-seconds
- `message_timestamp_type` (String) Message timestamp type
- `retention_ms` (Number) Retention period in milli-seconds
- `tenant_id` (Number) Filter by tenant. Specify tenant ID.

### Read-Only

- `capacity` (Number) Capacity of the Topic
- `num_events` (Number) Total number of events
